title.fr: Champ magnétique créé par un aimant

sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a draggable, rotatable bar magnet (N/S
poles color-coded). Canvas2D overlay renders magnetic field lines
(pre-computed dipole streamlines) around the magnet. A draggable
compass needle test object shows local B direction. HUD: magnet
orientation angle, compass angle, distance from magnet center.
Experiment: rotate and place the magnet so the compass at a fixed
target point aligns to a target direction (e.g., east). Evaluate:
field lines hidden; student must orient the magnet from scratch so
a hidden compass needle at a marked point ends up pointing at a
target direction. Wrinkle: field-line rendering uses a dipole
approximation; no numeric B (this exercise is about direction).
